extraction.notes: Read in full (pages 1-44). The fiche covers education, skills and employment; most of it is outside the run scope. Chapter 2 items (cluster 2, chapter 02) are the labour market situation of Ukrainian refugees in Moldova (page 9), as foreign nationals' access to the labour market. Theme items are online employment services, the digital transformation strategy and the digitalisation of active labour market services. Left out: emigration, the diaspora and remittances (pages 5, 8 and table 1.1), as nationals' emigration not linked to workers' rights or access; the share of foreign-born residents (6.2%, pages 6 and 8), which concerns residents rather than workers' access; the number of refugees (136 000) and their integration challenges in general (pages 5 and 9), which are not labour market claims; the digital competence framework, digital devices regulation, distance learning concept and other digital skills items (pages 5, 17-18 and 33), as digital skills not linked to an in-scope recommendation; the education management information systems (EMIS/SIME, HEMIS) and education data availability (pages 5, 13, 34), as back-office sector systems and statistics; general labour market, VET and ALMP content. The summary on page 5 that ANOFM works through the angajat.md platform is a passing mention and is not extracted separately from page 21. Second-pass check (PC-05) not yet done. G3 second-pass check (PC-05) by checker-GOV on 3 November 2026: no items added; judgement calls in review/RUN-2026-02/g3_qa. Stage 8 (2026-11-05): status set from sample to complete; extracted in full at the G3 sample under rules 0.5 with its second pass (review/RUN-2026-02/second_pass/), so not re-extracted (G4-D09: rules 0.6 apply without re-extraction).

items.stated_text: Document supplements in technical vocational education: In July 2024, the MER issued an order mandating that, starting with the 2024/2025 academic year, all students' documents in TVET must be generated automatically through the Education Management Information System (SIME).
